notes.title: Patch 0.9
notes.content:
Patch 0.9 is out now!
The following changes have been made:
[list]
[*]Enhanced cursor icon image quality
[*]Removed ability to choose .cur or .ani files for cursors (nobody has these laying around anyways!)
[*]Added "reset to default" buttons for each cursor, which resets the given cursor to the Windows default
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.8: GIPHY and Flickr Integration
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249569/c5ed7d5adb880e7ad223ff17d33a3840649a891a.png[/img]Well we've got a huge update here folks!

The following features have now been implemented into Cursor Engine:
[list]
[*]Ability to use GIFs and .ani files as your cursor
[*]Integration with Flickr, to select Flickr PNGs as your cursor
[*]Integration with GIPHY, to select from millions or GIFs as your cursor
[/list]

Be sure as always to report any bugs you find, and give recommendations for any future updates!
